description: Detect and vacuum volumes with high garbage ratio

admin_config_form.title: Vacuum Admin Config
admin_config_form.description: Admin-side controls for vacuum detection scope.

fields.name: collection_filter
fields.label: Collection Filter
fields.description: Filter collections for vacuum detection. Use ALL_COLLECTIONS (default) to treat all volumes as one pool, EACH_COLLECTION to run detection separately per collection, or a comma-separated list of names, wildcards, or regex patterns.

fields.name: volume_state
fields.label: Volume State Filter
fields.description: Filter volumes by state: ALL (default), ACTIVE (writable volumes below size limit), or FULL (read-only volumes above size limit).

fields.name: data_center_filter
fields.label: Data Center Filter
fields.description: Only vacuum volumes in matching data centers (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

fields.name: rack_filter
fields.label: Rack Filter
fields.description: Only vacuum volumes on matching racks (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

fields.name: node_filter
fields.label: Node Filter
fields.description: Only vacuum volumes on matching nodes (comma-separated, wildcards supported). Leave empty for all.

fields.name: garbage_threshold
fields.label: Garbage Threshold
fields.description: Detect volumes with garbage ratio >= threshold.
